name: Rebirth
overview: Scripture reveals that rebirth is essential for entering the kingdom of God, as Jesus clearly states that no one can see or enter this kingdom without being born again or born of water and the Spirit (John 3:3, 3:5). This new birth grants believers the privilege to become sons of God through faith in Christ (John 1:12). Jesus emphasizes the necessity of conversion and humility like that of little children for salvation (Matthew 18:3), and faith expressed through baptism is linked to salvation (Mark 16:16). The ongoing presence and teaching of Christ guide believers in living out this transformative new life (Matthew 28:20).
